dct_description_sm:
This layer features the locations of Long Term Care Residence within the City of Kingston. Long term care centres are classified as critical facilities for public safety and used in the EMCOP application for emergency planning. 

Data source: Points of Interest

Visit the city's website for more information about Long Term Care Residence in the area.
